nuggets.text: Buffaloes coach Deion Sanders is the only athlete to play in both a Super Bowl and a World Series.
Buffaloes coach Deion Sanders hit an MLB home run and scored an NFL touchdown in the same week in 1989.
The Buffaloes won at Georgia Tech 14-13 when Boo Carter blocked a 45-yard field goal try on the game's final play.
Buffaloes QB Julian Lewis hit tight end Charlie Williams for the go-ahead 20-yard touchdown with 37 seconds left at Georgia Tech.
Buffaloes edge rusher Lamont Lester Jr. had three sacks in the 14-13 win over Georgia Tech.
Ralphie, the Buffaloes' live mascot, is always a female bison, picked for smaller size and a calmer temperament.
Ralphie, the Buffaloes' bison, can hit 25 mph, and it traditionally takes five handlers to guide her around the field.
The south end zone at the Buffaloes' Folsom Field appears in the opening of the 1970s TV show Mork and Mindy.
The Buffaloes added 47 incoming transfers this offseason, including Alabama running back Richard Young.
Buffaloes offensive coordinator Brennan Marion, known for his Go-Go offense, was Sacramento State's head coach last season.
